body: Independently challenge the Bonfyre projection of Bernstein's signed volunteer protocol. Prove that ReceiptEnvelope/EvidenceGraph does not infer producer-workflow authentication from artifact identity, and that forge, hub HTTPS, or future discovery transport identity never becomes protocol authority. Include a counterexample where a valid DSSE artifact came from an untrusted producer definition or where a transport-local field changes without changing protocol semantics.
subject: Cross-provider challenge: keep artifact, producer-definition, and transport identity orthogonal
